seedfall.name: Seedfall
seedfall.description: Root begins its growing season with Seedfall — an old habit turned into ceremony. Seeds saved from last year are pressed into the earth together. Maren reads aloud the names of crops that once fed thousands, most of which no longer grow at all.

long_light.name: Long Light
long_light.description: The midpoint of summer is marked by staying outside past dark. No formal ceremony — Root's people sit in the community plot and watch the sky. Eli brings salvaged lanterns. It is considered good luck to be there when they're lit.

first_harvest.name: First Harvest
first_harvest.description: The village marks the season's first major yield. Maren leads a short ceremony at the community plot. Whatever comes out of the ground goes into a shared meal — even the small, crooked things that would not barter well.

the_dark_count.name: The Dark Count
the_dark_count.description: Deep winter. Root counts its stores and its people. This is not a celebration — it is a reckoning. Each household accounts for what it has and what it needs. The numbers are read aloud in the community hall, and then someone starts a fire, and then it becomes something warmer than it started.
